articles.description: A fatal accident occurred in Kalyanpur area of Kanpur when a speeding Thar hit a scooter. The collision caused significant damage as the SUV dragged the rider for nearly 20 metres. Eyewitnesses reported the occupants screamed after the crash and fled in another vehicle. Police took custody of the deceased's body and are investigating the incident using nearby CCTV footage.

articles.title: Bill Gates thinks policy like California’s 'rich tax' is only solution in AI age
articles.description: Bill Gates emphasizes the necessity for governments to tackle inequality as AI creates wealth disparities. He believes that relying solely on philanthropy is insufficient to address growing economic inequality. Gates has also proposed taxing billionaires and robots that replace human workers to ensure fairness in the economy. Research shows that a significant portion of stock market wealth is held by the top 1% of Americans.

articles.title: Weeks after flydubai incident, 'hostile aircraft' alert triggers panic in Israel
articles.description: An alert regarding a potential hostile aircraft intrusion in northern Israel was issued but later clarified. The alert prompted heightened scrutiny following an attempted hijacking of a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Israel has introduced tighter screening protocols for airlines in response to security challenges faced. Separately, the Israel Defence Forces discovered over 340 Hezbollah weapons during operations in southern Lebanon.

articles.title: 10-year-old Ukrainian boy tracks rare black stork from Chernobyl to Africa to expose threats to its survival
articles.description: Noah Beshto, a 10-year-old prodigy from Ukraine, embarked on an adventurous journey in a motorhome, tracking the migration of the black stork. Partnering with ornithologist Nika Paposhvili, he documented the hazards these birds face, such as electrocution and destruction of their habitats. Through his captivating series, Noah's Diary, he aspires to motivate children towards wildlife conservation, fostering potential collaborations among environmentalists.

articles.title: India's clean energy push may cut fuel import bill by $240 billion: IEA
articles.description: By the year 2030, India stands to save substantially on its coal and natural gas imports, with predictions from the International Energy Agency estimating cumulative savings of nearly $240 billion. A shift towards solar and wind energy will be essential for this transition, highlighting the importance of ongoing investments in infrastructure. India's journey in renewable energy could serve as a benchmark for other developing nations aiming for similar advancements.

articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway's profit falls 28% as Geico struggles: Warren Buffett's insurance giant under focus
articles.description: Berkshire Hathaway reported a more than 28% decline in third-quarter profit due to its insurance businesses. The conglomerate's insurance underwriting profit fell, primarily affecting Geico's performance significantly. Additionally, Berkshire's operating earnings decreased nearly 6%, missing analyst expectations as well. Conversely, non-insurance operations showed better performance under the leadership of Greg Abel, indicating relative stability. Furthermore, Berkshire repurchased $9.6 billion in shares while increasing cash reserves to $377.4 billion.

articles.title: ACC January 2027 entrance exam: NTA opens registration window; check exam schedule, fee and key details
articles.description: The National Testing Agency has commenced the application process for the Common Entrance Examination for Army Cadet College. Interested candidates can apply online until November 30, 2026, with a late fee option available. The examination is scheduled for January 4, 2027, and will be conducted in Computer-Based Test mode. Several category-wise application fees are applicable, and candidates should fill out only one application.

articles.title: Bhiwani girl secures AIR 15 in NDA, clears SSB in fourth attempt
articles.description: Nineteen-year-old Parul Dahiya from Bhiwani district has secured All-India Rank 15 in the girls' category in the NDA examination, overcoming three unsuccessful SSB interview attempts before clearing the selection process on her fourth attempt. A BTech student and aspiring Indian Air Force officer, Parul credits persistence, improved preparation and a positive attitude for her success. Inspired by an Army officer during her school days, she now encourages defence aspirants to remain sincere and work consistently towards their goals.

articles.title: Keerthy Suresh compares Bollywood and South film industry work styles
articles.description: Keerthy Suresh recently expressed her insights on the varying approaches between Bollywood and South Indian cinema. She observed that Bollywood generally emphasizes thorough pre-production and detailed actor preparation prior to filming. In comparison, South cinema embraces a more impulsive approach, with actors often only meeting on the day of the shoot. Additionally, she reflected on her role in the web series 'Akka' with Radhika Apte, noting their characters' dynamic differences.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 3 (LIVE)
articles.description: Ramayana opened strongly at the box office, earning Rs 64.85 crore on its first day in India. The film experienced a slight decline on its second day, with Rs 48 crore net on Friday. Positive word of mouth has led to boost the film's performance on Saturday and beyond. The film has made Rs 182 crore net in India by the end of day 3.
